name: vestigial-pair-activation-is-llama-config
written_before: any code. Reach measured over all 109 cached plans after wave 7.
the_fix: Two keys read by no implementation, ours or upstream, checked against transformers 5.5.0 by exact-word grep: Falcon3-1B-Base declares `activation: swiglu` beside `hidden_act: silu` under `model_type: llama` (LlamaConfig has no `activation`); SmolLM2-135M declares `is_llama_config: true` under `model_type: llama` (no hit anywhere). Same treatment as PR #375's `use_mrope` / `rope_interleaved`: read-and-check against the EFFECTIVE policy, never echo. `activation` agrees only when the built FFN is gated with the declared gate activation (swiglu == gated silu); `is_llama_config` agrees only when the resolved family is llama. A checkpoint declaring `activation: gelu` or `is_llama_config: false` under a llama stack refuses.
why_not_the_cluster: ffn_activation has reach 26 and unclustered reach 59; these two keys reach exactly one row each.
note: Written against the wave-7 baseline. If wave 8 lands first, add its deltas: GREEN 33, RED 69, blockers 1089.
